title: Ab Lysis Buffer Preparation
author: Colin Daniel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bft6jnre
materials: On ice add protease and phosphotase inhibitors (Roche)

steps.title: Prepare Lysis Buffer
steps.instruction: Combine reagents to achieve final concentrations of 20 mM Tris (pH 7.5), 50 mM NaCl, 0.5 % (v/v) Triton‑X100, 0.5 % (v/v) deoxycholate (DOC), 0.5 % (v/v) SDS, and 1 mM EDTA in water, mixing until fully dissolved.
